newsitem.title: USA: Cole National files for 1.5 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Cole National files for 1.5 mln shr offer.

text.p: Cole National Corp on Tuesday filed a registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1.5 million Class A common shares.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 225,000 additional Class A shares. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 13,625,030 Class A common.
The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, McDonald & Co Securities Inc and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
The company will use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include reducing outstanding debt.
Cole National, based in Mayfield Heights, Ohio, is a vision care and personalization retailer.
